$comment: Fixed Job profiles (contracts/jobs/job.schema.json#/$defs/profile). Only reviewed profiles here can be launched; the launcher never accepts an arbitrary image, command or volume. local-check-v1 is the trusted qualification fixture of P05: it runs no candidate code and no model call. codegen-fixed-v1 and harness-wiring-dev-v1 are the P09 harness profiles and validator-fixed-dev-v1 the P10 fixed validator profile (the harness layout with the anvilkit-validator image): their image digests are recorded from the reviewed builds, and the launcher additionally requires each profile to be enabled for its environment.

profiles.description: Fixed qualification fixture: computes the digest of a fixed input and reports a result manifest through the Pod termination message; the trusted observer verifies it against expectedResult.

Trusted harness with the fixed non-paid candidate task (P09b): the supervisor drops to the candidate UID, the observer verifies the output bytes, the finalizer submits through the access sidecar. Requires the gVisor RuntimeClass; DISABLED until its negative tests pass on the target runtime (G-04/G-05).

DEVELOPMENT_ONLY wiring fixture: the same trusted image, entrypoint, sidecar and fixed task as codegen-fixed-v1 on an unqualified runtime (no RuntimeClass). It verifies launcher templates, sidecar identity, the artifact flow and duplicate-Pod fencing on the development foundation; it qualifies no candidate isolation and is never enabled outside development.

DEVELOPMENT_ONLY fixed validator (P10d): the anvilkit-validator image runs the complete-source, protected-build and independent-certification chain on the reviewed fixed component baked into it (no candidate input, SSR host check only), uploads npm/browser/css/evidence through the access sidecar and submits the result manifest. Harness layout without RuntimeClass; it qualifies no candidate isolation and is never enabled outside development.
